results.corrected_title: OpenAI rolls out Slides in ChatGPT with real-time co-editing and PowerPoint export
results.corrected_summary: On 16 October 2026, OpenAI began rolling out Slides in ChatGPT to eligible Pro, Business and Enterprise users with Space access, on the web and in the desktop app. Users can build decks from a conversation, uploaded files or an outline, and can supply an example deck to guide style and layout. Teammates can edit the same deck in real time and leave shared comments. On the web, decks export to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides; the desktop app opens them in PowerPoint or Keynote.
key_facts: Rollout announced in ChatGPT release notes, dated 16 Oct 2026
Eligible: Pro, Business and Enterprise users with Space access; rollout is gradual
Inputs: a conversation, uploaded files, an outline, plus an optional example deck
Real-time co-editing and shared comments; there is no comment-only access role
Web export to PowerPoint, PDF and Google Slides; an export is a copy, and the live deck stays in Space
OpenAI first previewed the feature at DevDay on 29 Sep as coming in 'coming weeks'

other_sources.name: OpenAI Help Center – Creating and collaborating on slides in ChatGPT

results.issues: I could not open the OpenAI release notes or the WebProNews article (both returned 403), so the details rest on secondary outlets quoting the release notes and on search snippets. The candidate said Plus, Free and Go are not included. No source states this outright; they are only missing from the eligible list, so I removed the claim. The feature was previewed at DevDay on 29 Sep, but the actual rollout on 16 Oct falls inside the window.

results.corrected_title: Microsoft launches Copilot for Legal with legal plugins for Word and Cowork
results.corrected_summary: On 15 October 2026, Microsoft announced general availability of more than 20 purpose-built legal skills, delivered as legal plugins for Word and Cowork. In Word, Copilot reviews agreements against playbooks, drafts from approved templates and applies proposed revisions as tracked changes, but only with the user's approval. In Cowork, it runs multi-step legal workflows across files and apps, such as tracking obligations and building case chronologies. Partner plugins from firms including Bloomberg Law, Harvey, Legora, Docusign, iManage, Relativity and Everlaw began rolling out the same day.
key_facts: Announced 15 Oct 2026 on Microsoft's Tech Community Copilot blog
More than 20 purpose-built legal skills, generally available
Word: playbook review, drafting from approved templates, redlines applied as tracked changes
Cowork: multi-step work across agreements, emails, meetings and files
Partner plugins include Bloomberg Law, Harvey, Legora, DeepJudge, Docusign, iManage, NetDocuments, Relativity and Everlaw
Builds on Legal Agent, in Frontier since April with over 1,800 users; the Word plugin replaces the Legal Agent experience

best_source.name: Microsoft Tech Community – Introducing Microsoft Copilot for legal

results.issues: The core claims are confirmed. The detail that it requires Microsoft 365 Copilot commercial licences comes from Artificial Lawyer; Microsoft's blog says only that it is available to Microsoft Copilot customers worldwide. The claim that it replaces Legal Agent comes from Artificial Lawyer, which says the Word plugin replaces the Legal Agent experience; Microsoft's blog says the capabilities 'come together as legal plugins'.

results.corrected_title: OpenAI adds parallel agents to GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT
results.corrected_summary: On 16 October 2026, OpenAI upgraded GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT with faster responses and better use of plugins and tools. It also added parallel agents: several agents work on different parts of one task at the same time, and users can follow each agent's progress and review its finished work. The feature is rolling out to eligible Pro users. A separate update on 17 October lets subagents in Codex and ChatGPT Work reuse context and keeps cached context available for longer.
key_facts: Announced by OpenAI on X on 16 Oct 2026
GPT-6 Pro gets faster responses and improved plugin and tool use
Multiple agents tackle parts of a task in parallel, with progress tracking and review
Rolling out gradually to eligible Pro users; in managed workspaces, access depends on workspace settings
17 Oct: Codex/ChatGPT Work subagents reuse context, cached context lasts longer and routing is changed to raise cache hits
results.issues: I did not open the X post. I saw its text in a search result, and TokenPost, which I did open, confirms the 16 Oct date and the details. OpenAI published no benchmarks or latency figures. Some outlets report that OpenAI's edited post now calls the model 'GPT-6 Astra Pro', so the naming may have changed.
